note: One oracle for two implementations. The compiled server validator (api/src/report-citation.ts) and the later client comparator (S3-U2b) each implement the rule separately; if they disagree the person sees the same sentence called present on one surface and absent on the other. Every vector here is a whole-line, consecutive, non-overlapping block match after CRLF, lone CR and NFC normalization applied ONLY to the comparison operands - stored bytes are never normalized. `assembly` is S3-U2b's R5 template and is deliberately not exercised by U2a product code; it is pinned here so the two halves cannot drift.
normalization: CRLF -> LF, lone CR -> LF, NFC. The same equality decides both k (occurrences in a field) and sameTextCount (entries carrying the same text).

same text in different fields is not the same entry

sameText.why: n must use the same equivalence as k; the two compete for the same single occurrence

sameText.name: a leading line break is part of the block, so these are different texts

equivalence.name: final-LF variants share one occurrence and therefore share n

equivalence.name: CRLF and LF forms of one block share n

different blocks keep their own n and their own occurrence
a leading empty line is a different block and is absent from this field
the same bytes in two fields never share n
equivalence.why: k here is counted against the findings field for both, which is why the fields must key apart

measurement.note: Include Measurements (opt-in): the one line the screen adds under a cited finding block, and what the server checks of it. The screen composes it from text it already shows (the tool name, the saved value text of the source line, unverified warning included) and the DICOM SeriesNumber / InstanceNumber / NumberOfFrames read for that SOP; the server never recomputes a number. `parts` and `lines` are the screen's template; `problems` and `eligible` are answered by both halves (report-citation.js and api/src/report-citation.ts).

parts.name: DICOM JSON may give IS values as numbers; they are written as given
a mark without a value keeps its name and place
a number DICOM does not give is a dash, never a position
a multi-frame object names the frame
a known frame beyond 1 is never dropped, even without NumberOfFrames
frame 1 of a multi-frame object is still named
an unverified value is copied with its own warning
surrounding spaces of a DICOM IS value are not part of it

lines.name: sources in their order, joined by '; '

lines.name: the same text from two marks stays twice (no deduplication)
lines.line: 측정: Length 31.7 mm (Series 2 / Image 41); Length 31.7 mm (Series 2 / Image 41)

problems.name: the line ends the inserted text after one LF
a CR is a line break too
glued to the block without its LF
nothing of the finding before it

eligible.name: a current image mark of this study
a revised one still is (the copy is the finding revision's)
a comparison study's mark is not (its numbers are another exam's)
a saved view or 3D point is not (no Series/Image)
